questions: The GATE VERDICT is BLOCKED, so implementation is not allowed until governance changes this to QUALIFIED or PROCEED. Please confirm when the gate verdict for this task is updated.

Confirm full, verified behaviour for invalid requests (key invalid_request|behaviour, gap id A:dt:invalid_request|behaviour@v1) so we know exactly how to reject invalid inputs and whether to avoid store/screen/price/notify.
Confirm the normative flow order (key flow|order, gap id A:spec:flow|order@v1): should the API strictly follow validate>store>screen>decide>price>notify>respond, or is any deviation permitted?

Confirm the precise pricing algorithm (keys P1|formula, P2|threshold, P2|surcharge, P3|threshold, P3|factor, P3|order, P4|rounding: refs A:dt:P1|formula@v1, A:dt:P2|threshold@v1, A:dt:P2|surcharge@v1, A:dt:P3|threshold@v1, A:dt:P3|factor@v1, A:dt:P3|order@v1, A:dt:P4|rounding@v1) and promote them from proposed to verified/approved.

Clarify the required behaviour for notification failures (key QuoteAPI|on_notification_failure, ref A:dt:QuoteAPI|on_notification_failure@v1): is notification strictly fire-and-forget with no effect on stored quote or response, even on repeated failures?

Clarify when quote_id must be present in the response (key response|quote_id_presence, ref A:spec:response|quote_id_presence@v1): should quote_id be returned on every path where a draft was stored successfully (including review_hold, refused_screening, held_unscreened)?

assumptions.text: No assumptions may be applied because the gate verdict is BLOCKED; all proposed knowledge (e.g., pricing rules, invalid_request behaviour, notification failure handling, flow order, quote_id presence) must not be treated as implemented behaviour until verified or the gate is changed.

claims.text: Only knowledge at status verified or approved may be used as fact; validated and proposed knowledge require different handling, and BLOCKED gate forbids code generation.
On storage failure nothing else runs: no screening call, no pricing, no notification; status error: store_unavailable.
A screening outage does not fail the quote: the quote is priced, stored with status held_unscreened, not notified, and the response carries hold: true.
Response statuses must be one of quoted, review_hold, refused_screening, held_unscreened, 'rejected: invalid_request', or 'error: store_unavailable'.
The GATE VERDICT is BLOCKED, and rule 4 requires abstaining from producing code when the gate is BLOCKED.
